consistency: One native owner; atomic two-table writes and snapshot pair reads. Not a serializability or linearizability qualification.

fjall.durability: Every committed write batch uses PersistMode::SyncAll
fjall.native_compression: Default LZ4; native compressed/uncompressed byte ratio unavailable in this first profile

redb.transactions: Native write transaction across both tables
redb.native_compression: No configured value compression in this profile

deletes: Hard logical removal, separately from physical space reclamation
ttl: Not exercised; no application TTL emulation
idempotency: No automatic mutation retry. Every request has a new immutable pair ID; ambiguous intents reconciled independently.
topology: In-process libraries, no native cluster or replication. Owner, writer, reader and controller are independent processes in one container; fsynced witness on host bind mount outside the killed owner. This tests process crash, not container/host/disk/power failure.

payload.distribution: Deterministic synthetic ASCII with repeated and hashed portions; not production fitted

client.protocol: Private Unix socket request/response to native owner, full request latency includes transport/serialization
client.reads: Each read checks both copies in one native snapshot, for an ACKed recent ID and historical ID0

qualification: Functional/short operational diagnostics only; shared-host concurrent labs preclude a qualified comparative performance ranking
